cycle.note: CPE is recorded by calendar year. Each January 31 report covers the two calendar years just ended: at least 80 hours, 30–50 in each year.

requirements.label: Two-year total
requirements.note: Each January 31 report covers the two calendar years just ended: at least 80 hours, and only 50 a year count. Next year's report covers this year plus next year.

requirements.label: Minimum each year
requirements.note: At least 30 hours every calendar year (at most 50 count).

requirement.label: Idaho ethics course (new licensee)
requirement.note: A 2-hour Idaho state-specific ethics course (Idaho Accountancy Act and Rules) in the calendar year you're licensed. We count courses with "Idaho" and "ethics" in the title.

licensureYear.note: New licensee: once you record the 2-hour Idaho ethics course, your first year counts as 50 hours (2 ethics + 48 credited). No other CPE is due this year.

licenseDateHint: Idaho CPE runs January–December regardless of this date; the CPE report is due each January 31.
issueDateHint: If you were licensed this year, you only need the 2-hour Idaho ethics course this year.
limitsNotTracked: Self-study without review questions or an end-of-course assessment doesn't qualify.
toVerify: New-licensee credit: DOPL says recording the Idaho ethics course gives '48 non-ethics credits' — modelled as the licensure year counting 50 toward the 80 (not in the rule text itself).
Both Regulatory and Behavioral Ethics count toward the 4 ethics hours (the rule just says 'ethics').
Whether the 30-hour yearly minimum applies in the first full year after licensure (we require it).
